extracted.intended_audience: registered eFilers / patent practitioners submitting Corrected or Updated Web-based Application Data Sheets via USPTO Patent Center
extracted.subtask_description: Step-by-step procedural guidance for preparing and submitting a Corrected (or Updated) Web-based Application Data Sheet (ADS) in the USPTO Patent Center, including what fields may be edited, required signatures, fee and petition triggers, and file/attachment rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Registered eFiler and Customer Number association
rubrics_metrics.description: You MUST be a registered eFiler and be associated to the Customer Number used as the correspondence address of the entered application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only registered eFilers associated with the application's Customer Number may submit a Corrected Web-based ADS.

rubrics_metrics.name: Allowed submission types
rubrics_metrics.description: The Corrected Web-based ADS is available for existing applications under the following submission types: Utility (Nonprovisional), Reissue, and Designs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not attempt to use the Corrected Web-based ADS for other application types; use the appropriate route for those filings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prohibited application types for Corrected ADS
rubrics_metrics.description: The Corrected Application Data Sheet is not permitted in PCT, 371, Hague, Provisional, Reexam, Plant, and Supplemental Examination submissions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For these application types, follow the separate rules and filing methods required by the USPTO.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application filing date eligibility cutoff
rubrics_metrics.description: A Corrected Application Data Sheet can only be submitted in an existing application that was filed on or after September 16, 2012.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not attempt to submit a Corrected Web-based ADS for applications filed before this date.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not attach ADS as PDF
rubrics_metrics.description: Do not attach an ADS as a PDF if submitting a Corrected Application Data Sheet.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Patent Center will auto-generate a CorrectedADS.pdf; attaching a separate ADS PDF is not permitted and may cause processing issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Secrecy Order electronic filing restriction
rubrics_metrics.description: Submissions for applications under a Secrecy Order may not be filed electronically.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the application is under a Secrecy Order, use the permitted (non-electronic) filing channels.

rubrics_metrics.name: Session timeout and auto-save behavior
rubrics_metrics.description: Patent Center sessions will time-out after 30 minutes of inactivity. A Web-based ADS that has not been submitted after 30 mins of inactivity will be saved automatically for registered filers only.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only registered filers can retrieve saved submissions from the Workbench; save periodically and be aware of the 30-minute inactivity timeout.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to access Corrected ADS in Patent Center
rubrics_metrics.description: To submit a Corrected Application Data Sheet, select Existing Submissions, Upload Corrected ADS from the Patent Center navigation menu or Existing Submissions, Corrected Application Data Sheet from the Activities menu.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the specified navigation path to start a Corrected ADS submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required identifiers to start submission
rubrics_metrics.description: To start the Corrected ADS, you will need to enter the Application Number and Confirmation Number.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Click Continue to proceed; if there is a validation error, an error message will be displayed at the top of the screen and near the data field containing the error.

rubrics_metrics.name: PDP data retrieval may be incomplete
rubrics_metrics.description: On the Application Data tab, the Corrected ADS will be made available displaying data retrieved from the USPTO Patent Data Portal (PDP) system. Please note not all data may be retrieved.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The system only retrieves information stored in PDP; not all file-wrapper data may be reflected. If prior ADS or PDF ADS was used, PDP should contain the info. If only some inventor addresses are retrieved, you may need to enter missing addresses (entries show underlined if changed).

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not delete information you are not changing
rubrics_metrics.description: When submitting a Corrected ADS, do not delete information that you are not changing or do not want deleted, otherwise the Corrected ADS that is generated will provide an instruction to the Office to delete that information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only remove data you intentionally intend to delete; accidental deletions will be interpreted as instructions to the Office.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inventor information editing controls and underlining
rubrics_metrics.description: In the Inventor Information section, data of record will be displayed and editable. To make changes, type the new information on the web screen and it will be reflected with underlining on the Corrected ADS that is generated. Click the Pencil icon to edit and the 'X' button to delete.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Change inventor order by clicking the number on the left and dragging to the desired position. After edits, click Next section or Continue to proceed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inventorship changes require 37 CFR 1.48 requests and fees
rubrics_metrics.description: If you are adding or deleting inventor(s), then a request under 37 CFR 1.48(a) with the proper fee(s) must also be submitted. Note that both a processing fee and an additional fee may be due if the correction of inventorship is being made after the first action on the merits. If you are correcting or updating the name of an inventor, or changing the order of the names of joint inventors, then a request under 37 CFR 1.48(f) with the proper fee must also be submitted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure you file the appropriate 37 CFR 1.48 petitions and pay applicable fees when making inventorship additions/deletions or name/order corrections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Correspondence information non-editability
rubrics_metrics.description: In the Correspondence Information section, data of record will be displayed, but the data is not editable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To change correspondence address, use private PAIR or file in paper using USPTO form PTO/AIA/122, 'Change of Correspondence Address'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application Information required fields and entity status rules
rubrics_metrics.description: In the Application Information section, data of record will be displayed and editable. The Title of the Invention is a required field. You can claim small entity status by checking the box and properly signing the Corrected Web-ADS (see 37 CFR 1.27).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Special characters may not be entered in the Title field as they may not transfer correctly to USPTO databases. Loss of small entity status cannot be made via Corrected Web-ADS; a properly signed written notification pursuant to 37 CFR 1.27(g)(2) is required. Micro entity status requires appropriate PTO/SB/15A or PTO/SB/15B certification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Representative information display and power of attorney
rubrics_metrics.description: In the Representative Information section, data of record will be displayed, but the data is not editable. Providing representative information in the Application Data Sheet does not constitute a power of attorney in the application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To appoint or revoke a power of attorney, file a properly signed power of attorney (see USPTO Forms PTO/AIA/82, PTO/AIA/81, or PTO/AIA/80, which may require Form PTO/AIA/96).

rubrics_metrics.name: Domestic benefit / national stage editing and timing rules
rubrics_metrics.description: In the Domestic Benefit/National Stage section, data of record will be displayed and editable. If any domestic benefit claims are being added in a utility or plant application after the time period set forth in 37 CFR 1.78 (e.g., after the later of four months from the actual filing date of the instant application or sixteen months from the filing date of the application for which benefit is being claimed), a petition to accept an unintentionally delayed benefit claim in compliance with 37 CFR 1.78 (including the petition fee) must also be submitted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Deletion of a domestic benefit claim may be considered intentional waiver; ensure deletions are desired. When claiming benefit of more than one prior-filed application, present each chain starting with the most recent and proceed chronologically to the earliest. Change of order can be done with Add/X buttons or drag and drop.

rubrics_metrics.name: PDP internal codes used for benefit relationships
rubrics_metrics.description: When making a change to the domestic benefit claim, the Corrected ADS that will be generated will use internal PDP codes rather than the language that you use to specify the relationship. These codes on a Corrected Web-based ADS will be accepted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Common codes include: Continuation – CON; Division of – DIV; Continuation in part of – CIP A; 371 of international – NST; Substitution of – SUB; Reissue of – REI; Claims benefit of provisional – PRO.

rubrics_metrics.name: Foreign priority information and timing rules
rubrics_metrics.description: In the Foreign Priority section, data of record will be displayed and editable. Providing this information in the application data sheet constitutes the claim for priority as required by 35 U.S.C. 119(b) and 37 CFR 1.55.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Additional foreign priority claims may be added or deleted. Adding a foreign priority claim after the time period in 37 CFR 1.55 requires a petition to accept an unintentionally delayed foreign priority claim (including fee). Deleting a foreign priority claim may be considered an intentional waiver. Enter the WIPO DAS access code to identify documents registered in WIPO DAS if applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicant information roles and change requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: In the Applicant Information section, data of record will be displayed and editable. For each applicant entered, select either Assignee, Legal Representative under 35 U.S.C. 117, Joint Inventor, Person to whom the inventor is obligated to assign, or Person who shows sufficient proprietary interest.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Additional applicant info can be added/edited/deleted. Changing the applicant requires compliance with 37 CFR 1.46(c)(2) (which requires compliance with 37 CFR 3.71 and 3.73). Correcting/updating the applicant name requires a request under 37 CFR 1.46(c)(1); absent a specific request indicating a correction, the Office may treat it as a change in applicant and require a 37 CFR 3.73 statement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assignee information inclusion and publication rules
rubrics_metrics.description: In the Assignee Information section, data of record will be displayed and editable. Complete this section only if assignee information, including non-applicant assignee information, is desired to be included on the patent application publication in accordance with 37 CFR 1.215(b).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assignee-applicant identified in Applicant Information will appear as an applicant on the publication. Additional assignee entries may be added/deleted and reordered by dragging.

rubrics_metrics.name: Signature requirements and who must sign
rubrics_metrics.description: This form must be signed in accordance with 37 CFR 1.33(b). This Application Data Sheet must be signed by a patent practitioner if one or more of the applicants is a juristic entity. If the applicant is two or more joint inventors, the form must be signed by a patent practitioner, all joint inventors who are the applicant, or one or more joint inventor-applicants given power of attorney on behalf of all joint inventor-applicants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If an applicant is prosecuting pro se, all inventors must sign unless a power of attorney has been given. See 37 CFR 1.4 and MPEP 402 for signature requirements and certifications. You may add additional signatures using the 'Add more signatures' button.

rubrics_metrics.name: CorrectedADS.pdf auto-generation and edit-preview workflow
rubrics_metrics.description: Once you have made all necessary updates or corrections on the Application Data screen, a CorrectedADS.pdf document will be auto-generated. This document cannot be removed from the Attach Documents Screen.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the 'Preview' button to preview the document. If corrections are needed, return to Application Data, make changes, and click Continue to apply them. The corrected ADS identifies insertions with underlining and deletions with strike-through as stated in 37 CFR 1.76(c)(2).

rubrics_metrics.name: Permitted additional document types for submission
rubrics_metrics.description: If you have additional PDF documents, you may add them to the submission. The following document descriptions are made available for submission with a Corrected ADS filing: R48.REQ; OATH; LET.; R3.73; TRAN.LET; PET.OP; PET.PCT; CFILE; FRPR.IC.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Know the document code and meaning (e.g., Request under Rule 48 correcting inventorship; Oath or Declaration; Assignee showing of ownership per 37 CFR 3.73; Interim Copy of Foreign Priority Document). Attach only appropriate documents relevant to the ADS corrections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fee calculation and entity selection
rubrics_metrics.description: The 'Calculate Fees' screen allows eFilers to select the appropriate entity status in the top left-hand corner of the screen, adjusting the listed fee codes and amounts accordingly.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Available fees for Corrected ADS filings include Processing Fee (Except Prov. Appls.), Correction of inventorship after first action on merits, and Petition for the delayed submission of a priority or benefit claim, or to restore the right of priority or benefit. Ensure proper entity status (small/micro/large) is selected and signatures/certifications are in place when required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review Documents immutability for CorrectedADS.pdf
rubrics_metrics.description: On the 'Review Documents' screen, the CorrectedADS.pdf cannot be removed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you need to remove the CorrectedADS.pdf from the submission, you must cancel the filing and start over.

rubrics_metrics.name: Save submission feature for registered eFilers and required fields
rubrics_metrics.description: You have the option of saving the submission for later if you are a Registered eFiler. All of the required ADS fields on the 'Application Data' tab must be completed to save.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The save option is on the bottom of each screen. Patent Center will automatically save your progress each time you click 'Continue' to advance to the next screen; only registered eFilers can access saved submissions from the Workbench.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contacting Patent EBC for assistance
rubrics_metrics.description: If you have any questions or concerns regarding filing in Patent Center, contact the Patent EBC Monday - Friday, from 6:00 a.m. to 12 Midnight Eastern Time, by email ebc@uspto.gov or telephone 866-217-9197.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use these support channels for technical or procedural questions about Corrected ADS filing in Patent Center.
